observed.fact: Cross-channel editorial guidance existed in editorial council but lacked a single executable CMS copy-level trust rule, a customer-facing dashboard explanation, and a consistent proof-status distinction.
existing_controls: original company/personal LinkedIn hard editorial contracts

root_cause: Brand promise, channel editorial policy and CMS content validation were separately specified; high-confidence public-copy defects and proof limitations did not share a versioned CMS guard and visible owner portal explanation.
intervention: Pure deterministic trust assessment integrated into the ORIGINAL CMS quality gate, advisory brief carried through original council, existing owner-only executive cockpit explanation, agents and skills policy, no new writer or scheduler.
prevention_rule: All original CMS text, link, meta and HTML customer copy must be checked for high-confidence leaks, template instructions, false guarantees and quantified claims without references; links are not independently verified outcome proof. Existing human approval, channel prepublish and provider readback remain mandatory.
independent_verification_due: node tests on exact feature head
GitHub protected Required and CodeQL exact SHA
protected merge and exact Netlify production SHA/browser check
original Supabase Edge deployed source/readback where required
live original CMS approval sequence with authenticated editor
telemetry_boundary: Cannot infer trust uplift, publication, revenue, customer satisfaction or zero future errors from passing code tests.
